description.value: Glenmore Liquor Store is a neighbourhood alcohol retail shop located in the Glenmore district of Kelowna. It accepts cash, Interac, Visa, and Mastercard, and OSM records it as a no-drive-through location, suggesting a walk-in retail format. Cyclists passing through the area could stop for beer, wine, or spirits, though no cyclist-specific services have been confirmed.
